volcano.name: Katmai
volcano.summary: The Alaska Volcano Observatory (AVO) reported that on 14 and 16 November strong winds in the vicinity of Katmai and the Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes dispersed unconsolidated ash up to 1.8 km (6,000 ft) a.s.l. to the SE. The ash was originally deposited during the Novarupta-Katmai eruption in 1912.
